body: Your PR #922 (mac/evidence-remint-20260920) is reviewed and correct: mac-run.json goes 6906d8d9/v79 → 6cc9a0ee/v82, mintedAt 2026-09-20T13:51Z, proofsDocumented 60 → 63; the gating check 'Typecheck, build, and proof scaffold' is green and it does not conflict with SignalGrid_Alpha.
